raid(hasFaction==True)->Raiders of [FACTION_name] struck the settlement that had sheltered [PAWN_nameDef] after [colony], and when the walls fell they kept [PAWN_objective] alive.
raid(hasFaction==True)->[FACTION_name] came out of the dark with torches and rifles, and [PAWN_nameDef] was dragged from a cellar with the rest of the living.
raid(hasFaction==True)->When [FACTION_name] raided the farmstead where [PAWN_pronoun] worked, [PAWN_nameDef] stayed back to cover the others and was taken for it.
raid(hasFaction==True)->Years after [colony], a raid by [FACTION_name] found [PAWN_objective] in the quiet corner where [PAWN_pronoun] had hoped to be left alone.
raid(hasFaction==True)->The raid by [FACTION_name] lasted less than an hour, and [PAWN_nameDef] was among the few they bound instead of burying.
raid(hasFaction==True)->When [FACTION_name] raided what was left of [colony], where almost nobody remained, [PAWN_nameDef] was led away on a rope.

scarline(scars==True)->The cords were pulled tight, and the cuts they left on [PAWN_possessive] wrists never healed clean.
scarline(scars==True)->[PAWN_pronoun] fought them in the doorway and carries the scratches from that fight to this day.
scarline(scars==True)->A blade opened [PAWN_possessive] forearm in the struggle, and the scar is still there.
scarline(scars==True)->They dragged [PAWN_objective] over broken ground, and the scrapes healed into pale scars.
scarline(scars==True)->A guard's knife slipped as he cut the bindings, and the cut it left became a scar.
scarline(scars==True)->The first night they beat [PAWN_objective] to teach manners, and the marks of it have not faded.
scarline(scars==False)->The cords were pulled tight, but they left only bruises that faded within a week.
scarline(scars==False)->[PAWN_pronoun] fought them in the doorway and came away with scrapes that were gone by the next month.
scarline(scars==False)->A blade only nicked [PAWN_objective] in the struggle, and by spring there was nothing to show for it.
scarline(scars==False)->They dragged [PAWN_objective] over broken ground, but the scrapes soon healed without a trace.
scarline(scars==False)->A guard cut the bindings with one stroke of his knife and touched nothing else.
scarline(scars==False)->The first night they only shoved [PAWN_objective] about and shouted, and no mark lasted.
captive->Since then [PAWN_pronoun] has slept on straw behind a locked door and counted the days by the changing of the guard.
captive->The days have been much alike: thin soup, a rope at the ankle, and a lantern that is never put out.
captive->[PAWN_pronoun] was put to carrying water and scrubbing pots, and was watched for every step of it.
captive->Nobody has said what they want with [PAWN_objective], and nobody has said when it will end.
captive->[PAWN_possessive] name was shortened to a shout across the yard, and the questions stopped after the first week.
captive->Other captives came and went, ransomed, sold or simply gone, while [PAWN_pronoun] stayed where [PAWN_pronoun] was.
holdon->[PAWN_nameDef] keeps [PAWN_possessive] back straight and answers little, and gives no one the satisfaction of a plea.
holdon->[PAWN_pronoun] still mends [PAWN_possessive] clothes and washes whenever the water allows, because that, at least, is [PAWN_possessive] own to decide.
holdon->At night [PAWN_pronoun] walks through [colony] in [PAWN_possessive] head, room by room, so as not to forget it.
holdon->[PAWN_pronoun] has stopped expecting rescue, but has not stopped watching the gate.
holdon->A crust hidden in a sleeve, a nail worked loose from a board: [PAWN_nameDef] is patient, and keeps a list of small things.
holdon->Fear has not left [PAWN_objective], but it has learned to sit quietly, and [PAWN_pronoun] sits beside it.

drift->After [colony], [PAWN_nameDef] drifted from one job to the next, never staying long enough to be asked questions.
drift->The years after [colony] went by in borrowed rooms and short contracts, and [PAWN_nameDef] learned to keep out of other people's business.
drift->[PAWN_nameDef] left [colony] with no plan and took whatever road had a meal at the end of it.
drift->For a few seasons after [colony], [PAWN_pronoun] hauled, mended and guarded for anyone who paid on time.
drift->Nothing was waiting for [PAWN_objective] after [colony], so [PAWN_pronoun] went where the work was and the roads were open.
drift->[PAWN_nameDef] spent the years after [colony] on the edges of other people's towns, a hired hand with a good name and nobody to vouch for it.
trouble->Then, at a trading post, [PAWN_pronoun] saw something [PAWN_pronoun] was not meant to see, and made the mistake of looking twice.
trouble->A misunderstanding over a debt at a trading post turned into an accusation, and nobody there cared to hear the other side.
trouble->[PAWN_pronoun] witnessed a killing in a roadside tavern, and the man who gave the order noticed who was watching.
trouble->[PAWN_pronoun] had the bad luck to refuse a powerful man a small favour, and powerful men remember such things.
trouble->A caravan [PAWN_pronoun] had joined for a season turned out to be carrying somebody else's goods, and [PAWN_nameDef] was the one left to answer for the cart.
trouble->A letter [PAWN_pronoun] had agreed to carry for a stranger proved worth more than the stranger admitted, and several people wanted to know why it was in [PAWN_possessive] hands.
held(hasFaction==True)->[FACTION_name] decided the safest thing was to keep [PAWN_objective] under lock until the matter was settled, or paid for.
held(hasFaction==True)->Men acting for [FACTION_name] took [PAWN_objective] into custody, saying that a ransom would be named in due course.
held(hasFaction==True)->[FACTION_name] needed leverage over a rival, and [PAWN_nameDef] was the nearest person who could be spared.
held(hasFaction==True)->A magistrate of [FACTION_name] signed the order without reading it, and [PAWN_nameDef] was put in a cell to wait for someone to pay.
held(hasFaction==True)->Because [FACTION_name] could not afford a quarrel in the open, [PAWN_nameDef] was kept quietly, as something to be traded later.
held(hasFaction==True)->[FACTION_name] sent word to supposed kin, though nobody was left to answer.
held(hasFaction==False)->The people concerned decided the safest thing was to keep [PAWN_objective] under lock until the matter was settled, or paid for.
held(hasFaction==False)->Armed men took [PAWN_objective] into custody, saying that a ransom would be named in due course.
held(hasFaction==False)->Someone needed leverage over a rival, and [PAWN_nameDef] was the nearest person who could be spared.
held(hasFaction==False)->A local magistrate signed the order without reading it, and [PAWN_nameDef] was put in a cell to wait for someone to pay.
held(hasFaction==False)->Because nobody could afford a quarrel in the open, [PAWN_nameDef] was kept quietly, as something to be traded later.
held(hasFaction==False)->Word went out to supposed kin, though nobody was left to answer.
outlook->[PAWN_nameDef] insists there has been a mistake, and says so politely, every day, to whoever brings the bowl.
outlook->[PAWN_pronoun] has stopped arguing and started listening, because guards talk, and sooner or later one of them says something useful.
outlook->The ransom, if there is one, will not be paid by anyone [PAWN_pronoun] knows, and [PAWN_pronoun] is careful not to think about that after dark.
outlook->Held as leverage, [PAWN_pronoun] is fed and kept dry, which is both a mercy and an insult.
outlook->[PAWN_pronoun] keeps count of the days with notches on a rafter, and so far the notches outnumber the promises.
outlook->It is a strange sort of captivity, with no hatred in it, only paperwork and delay, and [PAWN_nameDef] is not sure which is worse.
r_story->[leave] [stars] [attack] [fall] [childhood]
leave->[PAWN_nameDef] left [colony] for the sky, signing on to a ship because the ground no longer held anything.
leave->After [colony] [PAWN_pronoun] took a berth on a freight ship, meaning to stay aboard for a year, perhaps two.
leave->One day [PAWN_pronoun] sold [PAWN_possessive] last tools to pay for passage off the planet, and never spoke of [colony] aloud again.
leave->[PAWN_nameDef] had always wanted to see another sky, and after [colony] there was nobody left to ask [PAWN_objective] to stay.
leave->Recruiters were hiring hands for a long haul beyond the rim, and [PAWN_nameDef] signed on the day [PAWN_pronoun] left [colony].
leave->[PAWN_nameDef] went up with a cargo of ore and a promise of wages, and all that was left of [colony] was weeds and memory.
stars->For years the stars were the only ceiling: orbital docks, rimworld ports, and long watches beside engines that never quite ran right.
stars->[PAWN_pronoun] worked the decks of three different ships, and learned that space is mostly waiting, with a little fear for flavour.
stars->Port by port [PAWN_pronoun] crossed the dark, trading hours of repair work for food and a bunk.
stars->The years aboard blurred into one long shift, lit by instruments and the odd cheerful stranger.
stars->[PAWN_nameDef] saw ice moons, bright orbital stations and an old red sun, and kept none of it, for there was nowhere to keep anything.
stars->Letters never followed [PAWN_objective] from port to port, and after a while [PAWN_pronoun] stopped writing them.
attack(hasFaction==True)->Over this world a warship of [FACTION_name] caught the ship in orbit and fired until the hull came apart, and [PAWN_nameDef] reached a pod.
attack(hasFaction==True)->[FACTION_name] came out of the glare of the sun without warning, and the ship broke up in orbit while [PAWN_nameDef] fought [PAWN_possessive] way to a pod.
attack(hasFaction==True)->Boarders from [FACTION_name] tore open the hull above this world; [PAWN_nameDef] remembers the air leaving, and then the lid of a pod.
attack(hasFaction==True)->In orbit, [FACTION_name] took what they wanted from the holds and left the ship to burn; [PAWN_nameDef] went down in the last pod launched.
attack(hasFaction==True)->A missile from a ship of [FACTION_name] split the vessel over this world, and the pod hit the atmosphere before [PAWN_nameDef] had finished strapping in.

attack(hasFaction==True)->The ship was already crippled when [FACTION_name] arrived over this world, and they finished it without ceremony; a crewmate shoved [PAWN_nameDef] into a pod and stayed behind.

attack(hasFaction==False)->Pirates came out of the glare of the sun without warning, and the ship broke up in orbit while [PAWN_nameDef] fought [PAWN_possessive] way to a pod.
attack(hasFaction==False)->Pirate boarders tore open the hull above this world; [PAWN_nameDef] remembers the air leaving, and then the lid of a pod.
attack(hasFaction==False)->In orbit, pirates took what they wanted from the holds and left the ship to burn; [PAWN_nameDef] went down in the last pod launched.

fall(scars==True)->The pod burned through the atmosphere, and the burns [PAWN_pronoun] took on the way down will leave scars.
fall(scars==True)->The landing crushed one side of the pod, and the injuries from it will heal into scars.
fall(scars==True)->Burning fuel splashed over the hatch as it opened, and the burns on [PAWN_possessive] arms will never quite fade.
fall(scars==True)->The pod struck the ground hard and folded around [PAWN_objective]; whatever mends, the scars will stay.
fall(scars==True)->Re-entry heat found a gap in the hull, and the burns will heal into pale, tight skin.
fall(scars==True)->[PAWN_pronoun] is still lying in the wreck, crushed and burned, and those wounds will leave their marks.
fall(scars==False)->The pod burned through the atmosphere, but the harness held, and the blisters on [PAWN_possessive] hands will be gone within a month.
fall(scars==False)->The landing crushed one side of the pod, but the other side held, and [PAWN_pronoun] is bruised from shoulder to knee and nothing more.
fall(scars==False)->Burning fuel splashed over the hatch as it opened, but [PAWN_pronoun] rolled clear and lost only a little hair.
fall(scars==False)->The pod struck the ground hard and folded, but nothing in [PAWN_objective] broke that will not mend.
fall(scars==False)->Re-entry heat found a gap in the hull, but the damage stopped at a scorched sleeve and a blistered ear.
fall(scars==False)->[PAWN_pronoun] is lying in the wreck half-conscious, shaken and sore, with nothing that will not heal.
r_story->[leave] [ambush] [wounds] [waiting] [childhood] [comrade]
leave->After [colony], [PAWN_nameDef] joined a caravan bound for the far markets, hired to guard the third wagon.
leave->[PAWN_nameDef] left [colony] with a salvage crew who swore they knew where the good ruins were.
leave->For a year or more after [colony], [PAWN_pronoun] rode with a small band of traders, sharing watches and a pot.
leave->The crew of a river barge took [PAWN_objective] on after [colony], and for a while it felt like family.
leave->After [colony], [PAWN_nameDef] signed on as a scout for a survey party, paid in advance and glad of it.
leave->After [colony], [PAWN_pronoun] fell in with a company of mercenaries, mostly decent people who spoke of a payday waiting at the end of the road.
ambush->Then one dawn the trail narrowed between two rocks, and the shooting began before anyone had time to shout.
ambush->The leader had sold the route to men who waited in the hills, and [PAWN_nameDef] learned of the bargain from the first shot.
ambush->The hired shuttle went down in the hills with a failed engine, and what the crash did not do, the panic that followed did.
ambush->A raiding party hit the camp at night, and those who were supposed to hold the line were the first to run.
ambush->A quarrel over the pay ended in gunfire at the fire, and [PAWN_nameDef] was standing in the wrong place.
ambush->The crew turned on one another over something small, a debt or a stolen ration, and when it was over the survivors left in a hurry.
wounds(scars==True)->A bullet went through [PAWN_possessive] side, and the wound will heal into a scar.
wounds(scars==True)->A knife found [PAWN_objective] in the confusion, low and deep, and it will scar.
wounds(scars==True)->[PAWN_pronoun] took two bullets running for cover, and neither will heal clean.
wounds(scars==True)->A stab wound under the ribs has gone untreated for days, and it will leave a wide, puckered scar.
wounds(scars==True)->A rifle shot shattered something in the shoulder, and the scars will feel the weather for years.
wounds(scars==True)->Somebody put a blade between [PAWN_possessive] ribs and left; if the wound closes, the scar will not fade.
wounds(scars==False)->A bullet only grazed [PAWN_objective], and the wound is clean enough to heal without a mark.
wounds(scars==False)->A knife found only a sleeve and a little skin in the confusion.
wounds(scars==False)->[PAWN_pronoun] took a bullet in the meat of the arm, and it will heal within the month.
wounds(scars==False)->A stab wound under the ribs missed everything that matters and should close cleanly in time.
wounds(scars==False)->A rifle shot spun [PAWN_objective] round and into the dirt, but passed through without breaking anything.
wounds(scars==False)->Somebody put a blade into [PAWN_possessive] thigh and left; it bled a great deal, but it will heal without a trace.
waiting->They left [PAWN_objective] under a rock ledge with a canteen and a blanket, taking [PAWN_objective] for dead, and [PAWN_pronoun] waited.
waiting->Nobody came back, and nobody was expected to; [PAWN_pronoun] lay there counting the shadows of the rocks.
waiting->For three days [PAWN_pronoun] waited by the cold fire, listening for an engine that never came.
waiting->Help was a thing that happened to other people, and [PAWN_nameDef] knew it, but waited anyway, because waiting was all that was left.
waiting->The abandoned wagon gave shade by day and a wall at night, and [PAWN_pronoun] lived on what the thieves had not bothered to take.
waiting->[PAWN_pronoun] bound the worst of it, said nothing to the empty hills, and waited with the patience of someone who has run out of better ideas.
r_story->[flight] [years] [slip] [now] [childhood]
flight->When nothing was left of [colony], [PAWN_nameDef] ran, and kept running until there was nothing behind [PAWN_objective] but trees.
flight->[PAWN_nameDef] walked out of the ruins of [colony] alone and did not stop at any door that was still standing.
flight->After [colony] there were too many faces and too many questions, so [PAWN_pronoun] went where there were neither.
flight->In the first winter after [colony] [PAWN_pronoun] took to the hills, meaning to come back in spring.
flight->Alone and without a plan, [PAWN_pronoun] fled the wreckage of the old life and found that the forest asked nothing.
flight->The morning after the last night in [colony], [PAWN_nameDef] was already a day's walk into the brush.
years->For years [PAWN_pronoun] lived like the animals around [PAWN_objective], sleeping in burrows and drinking from the same pools.
years->[PAWN_pronoun] ate what could be caught with bare hands and learned to sleep in the crook of a tree.
years->The seasons turned over [PAWN_objective] like water over a stone; [PAWN_pronoun] kept no calendar and wanted none.
years->Hunger taught [PAWN_objective] what books had not, and fear taught the rest.
years->[PAWN_pronoun] moved on all fours more often than not, and the hands that once held tools learned to grip bark.
years->Winters were spent in hollows lined with leaves, summers following game along the rivers, and for years nobody saw [PAWN_objective].
slip->Words went first, one by one, like coins from a torn pocket, and in the end [PAWN_pronoun] kept only a few.
slip->[PAWN_pronoun] forgot the names of things, then the names of people, and last of all [PAWN_possessive] own.
slip->A voice that was once used for songs and arguments now makes a few low sounds, and those mostly to the dark.
slip->What remains of speech is a handful of broken syllables, and [PAWN_nameDef] does not seem to know when [PAWN_pronoun] says them.
slip->Even the memory of [colony] faded, until it was only a feeling of warm light behind a door.
slip->[PAWN_pronoun] no longer remembers that names exist, and answers to a whistle or a thrown stone as readily as to anything.
now->Hunger, or perhaps loneliness, has finally drawn [PAWN_objective] out of the trees, watchful and thin as a fence post.
now->[PAWN_pronoun] edges toward the sound of voices, stops, edges forward again, and does not say a word.
now->Now [PAWN_pronoun] wanders into the open, flinching from firelight and staring at doors as though they were a puzzle.
now->[PAWN_pronoun] watches people from the edge of a clearing with a fixed, unblinking look, and shows no sign of knowing anyone.
now->When anyone speaks, the answer is a low sound and a step back, though sometimes the eyes seem to be searching for something.
now->[PAWN_pronoun] came out of the brush alone, unarmed and barely dressed, and stood there as if waiting to be told what comes next.
r_story->[leave] [solitude] [wild] [now] [childhood]
leave->After [colony], [PAWN_nameDef] could not bear the sound of other people's grief, and left to find a place without any.
leave->[PAWN_pronoun] carried the guilt for what happened in [colony] for one season, and then set it down at the edge of the forest, for no one else to carry.
leave->Nothing dramatic happened; [PAWN_nameDef] was simply tired, in the way that sleep does not mend, and the forest looked restful.
leave->When the last friend from [colony] was buried, [PAWN_pronoun] took an axe, a blanket and a sack of salt, and walked into the hills.
leave->The people around [PAWN_objective] meant well, and that was the trouble; [PAWN_nameDef] wanted to be nobody's burden, so [PAWN_pronoun] left.
leave->Years after [colony], [PAWN_nameDef] decided that the quiet of an empty valley was better company than any crowd, and went to find one.
solitude->[PAWN_pronoun] built a hut of turf and pine, and for a while lived well: a garden, a smokehouse, a shelf of carved spoons.
solitude->The first years were good ones, with a stove that drew properly and a stream that never froze.
solitude->Solitude proved bearable; the loneliness came only at dusk, and could be borne.
solitude->[PAWN_pronoun] kept to a routine, wood and water in the morning, snares at noon, a fire at night, and spoke to the dog until the dog died.
solitude->Visitors were rare, and [PAWN_pronoun] learned to be glad of that without saying so.
solitude->A trader came through twice a year for a while, then stopped coming, and [PAWN_nameDef] did not go looking for the reason.
wild->But the forest is patient: the hut sagged, the garden went back to weeds, and [PAWN_pronoun] let it all go, one winter at a time.
wild->Slowly the wild took the rest: first the clothes, then the tools, then the habit of fire.
wild->Day and night ran together, and [PAWN_pronoun] began to sleep where [PAWN_pronoun] fell, as the animals did.
wild->Mice moved into the roof, and then a fox into the doorway, and [PAWN_nameDef] moved out under the open sky, not unwillingly.
wild->The words went one by one, and [PAWN_pronoun] did not regret them; there was nobody left to say them to.
wild->In time the bark and the rain and the long cold made of a person something the woods recognised, and tolerated.
now->Now [PAWN_pronoun] has come down out of the hills, thin and brown and silent, not looking for anything in particular.
now->What brought [PAWN_objective] out is unclear: a fire, a smell of bread, or only that the stream had run dry.
now->[PAWN_pronoun] answers questions in single words, when at all, and studies faces for a long time, as if sorting old drawings.
now->A remnant of manners remains: [PAWN_pronoun] nods when thanked and steps aside in doorways.
now->[PAWN_nameDef] stands at the edge of things now, close enough to hear, far enough to leave.
now->Whatever [PAWN_pronoun] was looking for in the wild does not seem to have been found, and [PAWN_possessive] feet have turned back toward people of their own accord.
r_story->[casket] [wake] [time] [childhood]
casket->Sickness was loose in the settlement, and [PAWN_nameDef] lay down in a cryptosleep casket meaning to sleep out a single season.
casket->The famine that followed [colony] was long, and [PAWN_nameDef] chose the casket over the queue for bread, meaning to wake with the spring.
casket->With a siege tightening around the walls, [PAWN_nameDef] was put into a casket, along with a few others, to wait it out.
casket->[PAWN_nameDef] remembers the lid, the cold, and a promise to be woken in a season, and nothing at all after it.
casket->It was meant to be a short sleep, a few months while the worst passed, and [PAWN_pronoun] set the timer with [PAWN_possessive] own hands.
casket->The plague years after [colony] left few choices, and [PAWN_pronoun] took the one that let [PAWN_objective] sleep through them.
wake->[PAWN_pronoun] woke in a stone hall [PAWN_pronoun] had never seen, in a casket that was not the one [PAWN_pronoun] lay down in.
wake->The casket was old, older than anything [PAWN_pronoun] knew how to make, and the mark on its lid meant nothing.
wake->Dust lay on everything, and the corridor beyond the glass was a place of rusted doors, not the settlement where [PAWN_pronoun] had gone to sleep.
wake->[PAWN_nameDef] woke to the hiss of a seal [PAWN_pronoun] did not remember, in a chamber lit by a light that came from nowhere.
wake->Everything about the place was wrong: the walls, the hum, the metal under the glass. It was not where [PAWN_pronoun] went to sleep.
wake->[PAWN_pronoun] climbed out of the casket into a vault of dead machines, with a dry throat and the feeling of having missed a great deal.
time->A season, a year, a century: [PAWN_nameDef] cannot say, and the question sits in the throat.
time->[PAWN_pronoun] remembers everything about [colony] clearly, which is somehow the most frightening part, because it feels like yesterday.
time->Nothing about [PAWN_possessive] body shows the passage of time, and nothing about the room admits to it.
time->The names [PAWN_pronoun] knows come back in pieces, as do dates, and none of the pieces fit together.
time->How long [PAWN_pronoun] slept, and how [PAWN_pronoun] came to be in this place, are two questions [PAWN_nameDef] has stopped asking aloud.
time->[PAWN_pronoun] would like to believe it was only a season, and is careful not to look at the dust.
r_story->[job] [door] [blank] [childhood]
job->After [colony], [PAWN_nameDef] took a job guarding a team of surveyors, who paid well to be walked through old ruins and not asked what they were looking for.
job->[PAWN_nameDef] hired on after [colony] as a guard for a salvage outfit working a dead complex in the hills.
job->Work after [colony] was scarce, so [PAWN_pronoun] signed up to explore sealed ruins for a man who paid in silver and never gave a name.
job->[PAWN_pronoun] spent a season after [colony] as a lookout at a dig site, watching the ridge while others went underground.
job->A scholar hired [PAWN_nameDef] after [colony] to carry the lamps into an ancient installation that no map had a name for.
job->[PAWN_nameDef] took the work because it paid and because nobody there asked about [colony]; a door to the old world seemed a fair place to be forgotten.
door->The last thing [PAWN_pronoun] remembers is a vault door, thicker than a man is tall, swinging open on a breath of cold mist.
door->There was a door, then a hiss, and a mist so cold that it felt like a hand on the chest.
door->[PAWN_pronoun] remembers writing on the wall in a language [PAWN_pronoun] could almost read, and a white mist rolling out of the dark.
door->A seal gave way with a sigh, and the mist that came through it smelled of nothing at all, which was worse.
door->[PAWN_pronoun] stood at the threshold of a vault; someone behind said to wait, and a cold fog rose to the knees.
door->The vault door was the last clear picture: green light on the frame, a draught of cold mist, and then the dark closing like a hand.
blank->Everything after that is blank, not forgotten but absent, like a page cut out of a book.
blank->[PAWN_nameDef] cannot say what happened next, who came out, or how long the blank lasted.
blank->What lies between the mist and the waking is an empty place, and [PAWN_pronoun] has learned not to press on it.
